answer: Random jury sampling at the vine: each verdict draws 9 graders without replacement from staked identities. The mesa of stake weights enforces honest-majority draws — an attacker owning k of identities wins a full jury only k^9 of the time. A 10% sybil share captures just 0.0000001% of verdicts, so their voyage to swing outcomes costs far more than any payout. It works because exponential draw probability crushes linear stake accumulation.
